The letter {{AurB|e}} was the fifth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "esk", and corresponded to the letter /E/ in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
